gloss: the twelve zodiac animals; Chinese zodiac

definitions.gloss: the twelve zodiac animals; Chinese zodiac
definitions.explanation: The twelve animals of the East Asian zodiac, used to label years, hours, and directions. Each person traditionally has a zodiac sign based on their birth year, which cycles through the twelve animals.

examples.japanese: {十二支|じゅうにし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十二支|じゅうにし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{龍|たつ}だ。
examples.english: This year's zodiac sign is the dragon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十二支|じゅうにし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: People often draw the zodiac animal of the year on their New Year's cards.

notes:
The twelve animals appear in fixed order in any zodiac chart and on every New Year's card season.

THE TWELVE ANIMALS (in order):
- {子|ね}: rat
- {丑|うし}: ox
- {寅|とら}: tiger
- {卯|う}: rabbit
- {辰|たつ}: dragon
- {巳|み}: snake
- {午|うま}: horse
- {未|ひつじ}: sheep
- {申|さる}: monkey
- {酉|とり}: rooster
- {戌|いぬ}: dog
- {亥|い}: boar

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十二支|じゅうにし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to recite the twelve zodiac animals
- {十二支|じゅうにし}⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧: zodiac fortune-telling
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十二支|じゅうにし}: this year's zodiac animal

CULTURAL NOTE:
Asking someone's {十二支|じゅうにし} is a polite indirect way to estimate their age, since the cycle repeats every twelve years. The animals also traditionally name the hours of the day and the cardinal directions in classical Japanese astronomy.
